name: WooCommerce Post and Page Sell – Content Locker for WordPress
author: rsdp

sections.description:
The WooCommerce Post and Page Sell plugin allows you to monetize your WordPress content by selling individual posts and pages. With this plugin, you can set a price for each post or page and restrict access until the user purchases it. Perfect for bloggers, educators, and businesses looking to monetize exclusive content.

For advanced pricing options, such as calculating prices based on user inputs, check out our Measurement Price Calculator Plugin Pro.

Key Features

  • Sell individual posts and pages with WooCommerce.
  • Restrict content access until purchased.
  • Automatically creates WooCommerce products for each post/page.
  • Adds custom tabs in the WooCommerce “My Account” page for purchased content.
  • Compatible with all WooCommerce payment gateways.

Usage

Set Price and Enable Selling:
1. Go to any post or page you wish to sell.
2. In the meta box labeled “Page/Post Sale Settings,” check “Enable Selling” and set a price.
3. Update or publish the post/page.

Purchase Requirement for Viewing Content:
– The content of any post/page marked as for sale will be restricted. Users will need to purchase the content to view it.

View Purchased Content:
– Once purchased, customers can go to their My Account page, where new tabs named Purchased Posts and Purchased Pages will show their purchased content.

Donate

Support this plugin by making a donation. Your contribution helps us improve and add new features.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/woocommerce-post-page-sell directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Flush Permalinks: Go to Settings > Permalinks and click “Save Changes” to ensure rewrite rules are applied.
sections.faq:
How do I enable a post or page for sale?

Edit the desired post or page. In the “Page/Post Sale Settings” meta box on the right, check “Enable Selling” and enter a price. Save the post/page.

How do customers access purchased content?

Customers can access purchased content via the Purchased Posts and Purchased Pages tabs in the WooCommerce My Account section.

Can I change the price of a post/page after it’s published?

Yes, you can update the price in the meta box of the post/page editor. Note that this will only affect new purchases.
